question: How should the six-faced deity be installed after placement?
premises: The deity is first placed in the prepared location.
The six-faced one is the object of installation.
The installation is done while uttering the root mantra.
inference: After placing him there, one should install the six-faced deity while uttering the root mantra.
plain_english: Having placed him there, one should install the six-faced one while uttering the root mantra.
